description: This file contains utility functions for adding attributes to OpenTelemetry spans specific to different AI services like TTS, STT, LLMs, Gemini, and OpenAI in a Python project. It defines functions for setting semantic attributes related to different AI models and services for tracing purposes.

methods.name: str _get_gen_ai_system_from_service_name(service_name: str)
methods.description: Extracts a standardized gen_ai.system value from a service class name, with special mappings for well-known providers.
